svg.aria-label: New Funding workflow, top to bottom
svg.text: TRIGGER A Series A to D round in the last 7 days (Form D filing or announced round)
OUTCOME Meetings inside the spend window
Pulled daily from EDGAR full-text search; due within
15 days of first sale, so it often lands before the
News search for raises in the trailing 7 days;
anything older has been worked by everyone
Domain resolved in its own pass, since asking inline costs recall
Headcount, industry and location added to every row
A yes or no ICP verdict with one reason, before any
The teams hiring are what the money funds
Pick the buyer the round pays for
A sales tool goes to the sales leader, a finance tool to finance; the CEO only under 50 people
Each vendor only sees the contacts the one before it
Valid to the main campaign, catch-all to its own
ICP fit plus a round above the floor plus hiring in
your function: a Slack card, then a personal note
Go to the campaign, written to the CRM with signal
Congratulations is the trigger, not the message: open on what they will hire for next, one direct
Launch from its own inbox set
Starts the next business day; stops for any account that replies, books or shows as an open deal
